title: XiaoShi's Furniture
description: A Minecraft furniture mod that adds interactive furnishings with GeckoLib 3D animations, bringing life to players' kitchens and laundry rooms.
body:
Xiaoshi's Furniture brings a collection of beautifully animated, functional furniture blocks to your Minecraft world! Each piece is designed with GeckoLib animations and immersive interactions.

Features:

🔹 Microwave Oven - Cook food with style! Place raw food inside, close the door, and watch it cook with realistic spinning animation. Features a fully animated door and cooking cycle.

🔹 Water Dispenser - Stay hydrated! Fill it with water buckets, heat water using redstone, and collect cold, warm, hot, or boiling water in glass bottles. Compatible with Tough As Nails purified water!

🔹 Range Hood - Say goodbye to smoke! When powered, it automatically absorbs nearby area effect clouds (smoke particles) from campfires and other sources. Features animated vents and particle effects.

🔹 Washboard - The ultimate enchantment recycler! Remove enchantments from any enchanted item and convert them into experience points. Right-click with an enchanted item, watch the bubbles and particles, and get your experience back!

🔹 Custom Villager - The Furniture Merchant trades furniture items for emeralds! Find him in your villages and expand your furniture collection.

🔹 Jade Integration - Fully compatible with Jade (Hwyla/Waila) mod for detailed tooltip information on all furniture blocks.
